info.title: Roha proposed API surface
info.description: Planning contract only; no server is included. The browser SDK performs live DOM discovery and action resolution. Host authentication, permissions, final approval and private recipient separation remain authoritative. No generic execute-code or click-arbitrary-URL endpoint is provided.

servers.description: Placeholder origin; replace only with an authorised host service

get.description: Return actual provider/device/language capabilities. Planned examples must not be presented as measured availability.

post.description: Optional structural validation only. This does not approve an action. The frontend runtime must separately resolve the fresh map/DOM target, visibility, host permission and actual learner confirmation. Client-supplied data cannot grant authority.

200.description: Schema validation result; no action executed

post.description: Optional configured provider route. Collect audio-processing consent first, state whether this is local/LAN/remote, enforce limits, and do not retain raw audio by default. Language availability must be checked; this contract does not guarantee all four languages.

429.description: Provider capacity reached; preserve the form and offer retry/text

503.description: Provider is not configured or available

HostSession.name: roha_host_session
HostSession.description: Illustrative host-managed session. Integrate with the real host's authentication and CSRF controls; do not expose a shared model API key in the browser.

Unauthorised.description: Host authentication is absent/expired; preserve permitted progress and explain recovery
